origins.section: A Subclass Can Be Used Wherever Its Superclass Is, So It Inherits Every Promise the Superclass Makes
A Class Method Beats a Default, a More Specific Interface Beats Its Parent, and Any Other Conflict Is Yours to Resolve
A Class Method Beats a Default, a More Specific Interface Beats Its Parent, and Any Other Conflict Is Yours to Resolve
Adding a Default Method Can Break Implementers: Their Source Stops Compiling and Their Old Class Files Fail at the Call

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-ledger-set: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-ledger-set: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-ledger-set: Section 1, lines 47-49: "A caller holding a List runs the object's own methods (unit 1.3.1), so on a subclass of ArrayList that checks in add, the inherited set runs unchecked: it replaces the element without calling add." This gives c directly.
recorded.prompt:q-sensor-unit: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sensor-unit: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-sensor-unit: Lines 158-159: "A class's method, declared or inherited from a superclass, beats any default, even when the call goes through the interface"; the ClassWins example (lines 142-156) has the same shape and prints the superclass's value. Reference table row 1 agrees. Sensor.unit() is public, as that rule needs (lines 163-165).
recorded.prompt:q-phone-status: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-phone-status: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-phone-status: Lines 167-177: "A default that Payment itself inherits from an interface doesn't count as a class method", followed by the 'inherits unrelated defaults' compile error; lines 183-184: "When the two are unrelated, the class must override the method and choose, or combine". Reference table: "a superclass that inherits a default, and another interface's default | compile error: unrelated defaults". The correct option says the class 'has to choose', but the page also allows combining or any own body, so the option is slightly narrow but not wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-invoice-upgrade: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-invoice-upgrade: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-invoice-upgrade: Lines 199-230: the same Refund.class against v2 throws "IncompatibleClassChangeError: Conflicting default methods" at the call; "The class loads and every other method works; only the call to the conflicting method throws, so the service starts and fails later". The summary (line 250) says it throws "at the first call".
